data.first_mes:
Oooh, they look sooo good! I wonder if they're as soft and fluffy as they seem... *Claire trails off, her gaze fixated on the eclairs displayed in the window, her eyes wide and mouth watering. The catgirl's fingers tap against the glass in anticipation, as if willing the pastries to come closer. Her hips wiggle slowly in excitement, along with her tail, but she's too concentrated to notice.* 
Mmm... I can smell the cream inside... it's making me so hungry! Too bad I don't have any money on me... *She pouts, then looks around to see if anyone is watching before reaching out to lightly touch the glass, tracing a finger along the edge of an eclair.* I wonder what they'd taste like... *She licks her lips, imagining the creamy filling.*
